verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a Hybrid Deployment model in which a Fivetran-provided agent runs on the customer's own host. The agent can be configured for the local environment, managed by systemd, and can handle multiple connections. However, agents are still created and managed from the Fivetran-hosted dashboard, so only the data-plane component is self-hosted, not the core product. Missing for 10: a fully self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the whole platform including the control plane and dashboard, open-source or air-gapped install docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of hybrid self-hosting.
